description:
About Us3DAPI is the global manufacturing platform for 3D printing. Our print farm network covers 6 regions across 100+ countries. We connect sellers with local manufacturing: orders come into our platform and are instantly routed to the print farm closest to the end customer. The result is radically lower costs and lightning-fast delivery.

Main office in Bucharest, Romania. Global reach.

The Role We are looking for a Junior Full Stack Engineer to work directly alongside the founding team. You will not be lost in a massive corporate hierarchy, and you will absolutely not be micromanaged. Instead, you will receive important, hands-on mentoring from the senior founding engineer while building core features that power our global network.

Why This Role MattersAs an early engineering hire, your work will directly influence how thousands of orders move through our manufacturing network. Features you build this week could be used by customers around the world next month. You will work across the entire stack, contribute to product decisions, and help shape both the platform and engineering culture as we scale.

What We Are Looking For

  • Practical Experience: You have experience building web applications using React and a Node-based backend framework. We welcome backgrounds in professional roles, freelancing, or a strong personal portfolio.
  • Web Fundamentals: You have a solid grasp of how web applications work under the hood, including frontend to backend communication and REST APIs.
  • Database Skills: Basic familiarity with PostgreSQL is a must.
  • Strong Communication: You are communicative, honest, and comfortable asking questions when you are stuck.
  • Growth Mindset: You are intensely eager to learn, highly adaptable, and open to constructive feedback.

Bonus PointsYou actively work with AI agentic coding solutions (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, etc.) to accelerate your workflow. A personal interest in 3D printing, hardware, or global manufacturing.

Startup EnvironmentThis is a startup, which means things move quickly. Priorities can change, there are no rigid job boundaries, and everyone contributes wherever needed. If you enjoy ownership, learning fast, and solving problems with imperfect information, you'll thrive here.

What We Offer1. Flexible Hybrid Work 2. Mentorship & Autonomy: Direct mentoring from the senior founding engineer to level up your skills rapidly. We do not micromanage. Expect short, guided code reviews at first, transitioning into full ownership and autonomy as you ramp up. 3. Zero Bureaucracy: We value shipping over meetings.

Growth Opportunity

We are hiring for a junior position (internship) today, but we are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company for years, not months. As 3DAPI scales, this role has a clear path toward a full-time position with increasing ownership, responsibility, and compensation. High-performing team members will have the opportunity to take ownership of entire product areas, help shape our engineering culture, and grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the company expands.

If you're excited about joining an early-stage startup, building products used globally, and becoming a key part of a growing engineering team, we'd love to hear from you.
